title: CPU Inference Bottleneck Map + Model-Residency SDI Plan
core_bottleneck_thesis: For CPU dense-model inference on 15GB RAM, the problem is almost always memory (capacity + bandwidth), not compute. Quantization alone is insufficient — it helps capacity but not the fundamental memory-access-per-token pattern.

ram_capacity_analysis.bottleneck: 30B likely OOM or swap-bound on current hardware

ram_bandwidth_analysis.root_cause: Every token requires streaming full weight matrices from RAM. CPU matmul is memory-bound.
ram_bandwidth_analysis.prt_lesson: Custom-op overhead layered on weight streaming without bandwidth reduction. Speed deficit from kernel overhead, not format.
ram_bandwidth_analysis.implication: Format conversion without memory-layout optimization doesn't win on bandwidth.

compute_analysis.bottleneck: Memory bandwidth dominates — model rarely hits FLOP limits

kv_context_analysis.32k_context: ~12.8GB KV for 30B (exceeds free RAM on 15GB machine)
kv_context_analysis.prefill_vs_decode: Prefill is compute-bound; decode is memory-bound per step
kv_context_analysis.problem: KV grows until it becomes significant RAM fraction; triggers swap or model reload
kv_context_analysis.opportunity: Most KV entries in typical session are redundant

model_residency_sdi_definition.description: System-level approach to reducing dense model memory footprint by controlling what model data must be resident, streamed, decoded, or activated per token — while preserving correctness anchors and native fallback paths.
not: Prompt routing (doesn't compress single model memory)
Speculative decoding only (doesn't reduce memory per pass)
PRT only (custom-op path was slower than native Q4_K_M)
specifically_targets: Weight residency — which components must be in RAM right now?
Activation sparsity — which components need to fire for this token?
Memory layout — optimized for CPU cache lines?
Streaming strategy — can we page weights in/out without recomputing?
Context management — reduce KV growth without losing information?
model_residency_sdi_definition.control_plane: Smart Agent Router orchestrates these mechanisms dynamically based on prompt characteristics, available RAM, latency requirements, and quality constraints.

path_1_native_layout_sidecars.question: Can we store parts in CPU-native compressed format without custom-op overhead?
cons: Still streams full weights per token per layer
path_1_native_layout_sidecars.assessment: Medium-long term. Not immediate next step.

path_2_sparse_ffn.question: Can dense FFN layers be converted so only subset of channels/blocks are evaluated per token?
path_2_sparse_ffn.assessment: High potential but high risk. Research only until fallback exists.

path_3_kv_context_compression.question: Can we reduce KV growth and prompt waste?
cons: Requires careful evaluation of what to drop
path_3_kv_context_compression.assessment: 🥇 HIGHEST NEAR-TERM PRACTICALITY. Low risk, moderate effort.

path_4_speculative_decoding.question: Can we run big model fewer times via small draft model?
path_4_speculative_decoding.assessment: 🥈 STRONG COMPONENT. Best as part of SDI stack, not the whole answer.

path_5_sdi_controller.question: Can Smart Agent Router orchestrate dense/speculative/compressed/local paths?
pros: Transforms existing infrastructure into intelligent SDI
path_5_sdi_controller.assessment: 🥉 STRATEGIC. This is the long-term productizable stack.

path_6_new_cpu_format.question: Is the right path a CPU-native model/runtime from scratch?

recommended_next_phase.title: Model-Residency SDI Architecture Spec
scope: Document SDI control plane architecture in design doc
Define interface between Smart Agent Router and KV/context compression mechanisms
Specify how ContextOS connects to VaultBrain (persistent) and inference session KV (ephemeral)
Identify first concrete integration point between existing components
Determine what success means for a demo
recommended_next_phase.why: PRT is frozen. Next win is the control plane orchestrating existing components. SDI stack is where the product story lives.
success_criteria: At least one concrete path from router → KV compression mechanism identified
Clear interface between ContextOS session memory and VaultBrain persistent memory defined
No code written yet — design-only phase
kill_conditions: No concrete integration point between existing components identified
KV compression quality loss proves too high in early probe
Router architecture can't support the policy layer
continue_conditions: Clean architecture mapping to demonstrable components
At least one measurable win (KV reduction ratio or speedup) in smoke test
